items.passage: Last Saturday, Ben and his sister went to the sea with Mom. The weather was warm, and the water was blue. They saw small fish next to the boat. Ben had a red ball, so they played on the sand. Mom bought bread and milk. They ate lunch under a tree. At home, Ben made a card with a sea picture.
